ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to scarring and trailing edge highlights, approximately a 1:5 ratio of white to black across the visible plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear clusters concentrated on the lower-left fluke margin; scattered white punctate spots across the medial left lobe; complex curvilinear white patterns on the upper-right lobe; solid white highlights along the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 40 to 50-degree U-shaped depression; however, the precise vertex is partially obscured by high-velocity water spray and turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-depth variations ranging from 3 to 12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into sharp, slightly recurved distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-6 pixels in diameter) visible on the medial surface of the left lobe and the anterior portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional linear pixel disruptions; vertical parallel lines on the left lobe and distinct concentric/curved horizontal rake marks across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white-on-black linear scarring patterns (rake marks) covering approximately 30% of the visible ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric/circular rake mark pattern located on the upper-medial region of the right lobe fluke.
